listing.trademark_check: Legal Desk screen 2026-10-05 (before any art): web searches '"Pumpkins and Purrs" trademark clothing', '"Pumpkins & Purrs" OR "pumpkins and purrs" shirt brand etsy' and '"cozy spooky season" trademark' found no PUMPKINS AND PURRS or COZY SPOOKY SEASON registration, filing or apparel brand. Nearby but different: PUMPKINS AND TIGERS (children's clothing, 1986-87 filings), PUMPKIN (Pumpkin Babes, baby clothing), FELINE (Purr Inc.), 'Purrs and Boos' (a fabric collection). We use the full phrase only, never PUMPKIN alone as a brand. 'Spooky season' is used as a common descriptive term. Kept out: 'Hocus Pocus' (film), 'Purrfect' wordplay already common in brand names, any character. tmsearch.uspto.gov, Justia and uspto.report pages are blocked from our sessions, so the official database was not searched directly; this is a search-engine screen, not a clearance.
